changelog: New: Smart AutoPilot acts on how full your internet line is, slows the biggest users first, and removes its own limits when the line is free again
New: internet speed and a Re-measure button on the AutoPilot card (speed test to Cloudflare, no device data sent)
New: real device names from your router, from what devices announce, and from their traffic; rename any device by double-clicking it
New: inactive devices are hidden after 10 minutes, with a Forget button; a device that gets a new IP stays one row and keeps its limit
New: AI chat understands Mbps/KB/s, 'him / it / everyone', and asks before acting when unsure
Improved: the AI model only runs when needed, so it no longer uses several GB of memory all the time
Improved: the device list stays smooth on big networks
Fixed: AutoPilot never touches devices you protected or limits you set yourself
Fixed: limits keep working after a modem restart or Wi-Fi drop
Fixed: trusting a device removes its Limit/Block buttons right away
Fixed (security): Grafana gets its own random password instead of admin/admin; Prometheus is only reachable from this PC
